plan.notes: Official East Carolina University 2026-2027 Management Information Systems BSBA requirements. The catalog publishes official degree requirements with no official semester sequence; collected as a single requirements block. Shared BSBA cores (Gen Ed 40, Business core 36, Cognates 3, Leadership/PD 9) are official, taken from the ECU Degree Explorer Supply Chain Management BSBA page Shared BSBA Cores section. The MIS concentration-specific courses (18 s.h.) were NOT captured (catalog page blocked text fetch) and are recorded as a visible placeholder block, not hidden. Catalog program total is 120 s.h.; captured blocks sum to 106 s.h. Per-course credits are NOT published and were not invented.

courses.title: General Education (40 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 40 s.h. general education block (shared BSBA core); per-course credits not published. Includes: COMM 2020 or 2410; ECON 2113; ECON 2133; MATH 1065 or higher; PHIL 1175 or 2274 or 2275; PSYC 1000 or SOCI 2110 (3 s.h.); additional gen ed courses to 40 s.h.

courses.title: Business core (36 s.h., shared BSBA core)
courses.choice_note: 36 s.h. business core block (shared across BSBA concentrations); per-course credits not published. Courses: ACCT 2401, 2521; FINA 2244, 3724; MGMT 3202, 4842; MIS 2223, 3063; MKTG 3832; OMGT 3123, 3223; one international perspectives course (ACCT 4451 / FINA 4454 / MGMT 3352 / MGMT 3552 / MKTG 3852 / MKTG 4992). Admission to concentration requires 45 s.h., 2.5 GPA, and C- or better with 2.5 average in ACCT 2401, ACCT 2521, ECON 2113, ECON 2133, FINA 2244, MATH 1064, MATH 2283, MIS 2223.

courses.title: Cognates (3 s.h., shared BSBA core)
courses.choice_note: 3 s.h. cognates block; per-course credits not published. ENGL 3880; MATH 2228 or MATH 2283.

courses.title: Leadership and professional development (9 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 9 s.h. block; per-course credits not published. BUSI 1200, 2200, 3200, 4200; Leadership and Professional Development Portfolio required before graduation.

courses.title: MIS concentration (18 s.h.) - COURSES NOT CAPTURED
